description: HydroWatch Quetta is an AI-powered platform tackling urban water stress and groundwater depletion in Quetta. By integrating NASA satellite data, including GRACE-FO and GPM, into a Graph Convolutional Network, the system forecasts water-stress zones and verifies municipal pipeline leaks to ensure sustainable water management.
